reviewNotes: Reviewed all 115 exported keys from 20 cards against data/pages38.json source furigana and seasoning vocabulary. Sentences, explanations and procedural/causal answer clauses use 1.0; seasoning names and short noun/quantity fragments use 0.85. Topic は -> わ selected by exact key/occurrence; lexical はいり/はいらない/はいる, はたらき/はたらく, はやさ/はやく, はっきり and ごはん preserved. Directional やさいへ, さけへ and ぜんたいへ -> え; lexical へいじつ, へらす and へんか retained. Object を -> お. Explicit spoken quantities: 200g にひゃくぐらむ, 1g いちぐらむ, 20g にじゅうぐらむ, 10% じゅっぱーせんと, 20〜30分 にじゅっぷんからさんじゅっぷん. Checked 塩麹しおこうじ, 醤油麹しょうゆこうじ, 米酢こめず; all remaining source readings retained. Katakana converted preserving long vowels/gemination (じゅーしー, れしぴ, こく, すーぷ). Final fragment punctuation added. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
